caption:
After a summer of trail runs and soft-sand jogs, Toto has an ache along the outside of his ankle. The peroneal tendons are a common reason.

These tendons run behind the bony bump on the outside of your ankle and steady your foot on uneven ground. They often get cranky after a jump in load, a new trail, long sand walks or an old sprain that never quite settled. Ease back without stopping altogether, then build up with band work, calf raises and balance drills. Supportive shoes help too.

Snapping behind the ankle bone, swelling that won't ease or an ankle that keeps giving way are worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.
